remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# reg.exe is all Rust (reg-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/reg-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# add.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/reg-rust/src/reg/add.rs)
# copy.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/reg-rust/src/reg/copy.rs)
# delete.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/reg-rust/src/reg/delete.rs)
# export.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/reg-rust/src/reg/export.rs)
# import.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/reg-rust/src/reg/import.rs)
# query.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/reg-rust/src/reg/query.rs)
# reg.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/reg-rust/src/reg/reg.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(reg_shims OBJECT rust_varargs_shim.c)
target_compile_definitions(reg_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(reg_res OBJECT reg.rc)
target_compile_definitions(reg_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(reg_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
target_compile_definitions(reg_shims PRIVATE _CRT_NON_CONFORMING_SWPRINTFS)
set_wine_module_fixme(reg_shims)
target_compile_definitions(reg_res PRIVATE _CRT_NON_CONFORMING_SWPRINTFS)
set_wine_module_fixme(reg_res)
add_cargo_module(reg reg-cargo reg.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE reg-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS reg_shims reg_res psdk)
